decision_conditions: This development shall be begun within three years from the date of the date of the original permission (22/01359/FUL) dated 24.08.2023.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the detailed drawings approved under  application ref: 23/02476/CLC and retained permanently thereafter, as far as they are not altered by the subject S73 application hereby approved. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the mechanical ventilation and heatrecovery strategy approved under application ref: 24/00081/CLC and retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of neighbour occupiers and a satisfactory appearance of the building in accordance with Policy DM10 of the RBKC Core Strategy.

The rating level of the noise determined by the cumulative sound emissions of the plant hereby permitted shall not exceed those stated in table 12 of the Noise Assessment Report dated February 2022.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of existing and future occupiers within and surrounding the application site in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Where emergency generation plant is installed and needs testing, the Local Planning Authority will permit the LAeq,T noise level from this plant to be no greater than 5dB above the existing background noise level when measured 1m externally to the nearest residential facade for the purpose of testing for up to one hour per month between 09:00 and 16:00 hours Monday to Friday only and not on public or bank holidays.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of existing and future occupiers within and surrounding the application site in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the sound transmission reduction measures approved under  application ref: 23/02480/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: to safeguard the amenities of existing and future occupiers within and surrounding the application site in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

In the event of any activity being undertaken within the premises which would fall under Class E(b), (d), and (f) a scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority for the acoustic insulation of the building to ensure that any neighbouring residential and/or commercial occupiers are not adversely affected. The scheme shall be implemented before the E(b) or (d) or (f) use commences and thereafter permanently retained.Reason: to safeguard the amenities of existing and future occupiers within and surrounding the application site in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

In the event of any activity being undertaken within premises which would fall under Class E(a), (b) and (d) these premises shall not be used by the public for the purposes hereby permitted before 8am and after 11pm Monday to Saturday and before 8am and after 10:30pm SundaysReason: to safeguard the amenities of existing and future occupiers within and surrounding the application site in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The site and building works required to implement the development shall be only carried out between the hours of 08.00 and 18.00 Mondays to Fridays and between 08.00 and 13.00 on Saturdays and not at all on Bank Holidays and Sundays. Reason: to safeguard the amenities of existing and future occupiers within and surrounding the application site in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

Prior to first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a residential and commercial travel plan shall have been submitted to and approved by the LPA. The Travel Plans shall be provided to residents and implemented in accordance with the approved documents.Reason: To encourage the use of alternative means of travel to the private car and encourage greater use of public transport, cycling and walking as an alternative

All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the GLA's supplementary planning guidance "Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition" dated July 2014 (SPG), or subsequent guidance. Unless it complies with the standards set out in the SPG, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time, whether in use or not, without the prior written consent of the local planning authority. The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.london/Reason: To comply with the London Plan's SPG on Sustainable Design and Construction and Policy SI1 of the London Plan 2021 in relation to air quality.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the Waste Management Strategy approved under  application ref: 23/02483/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: to ensure waste collection does not adversely affect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and the free flow of traffic on Hawks Road or surrounding streets.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the Flood Warning and Evacuation Plan approved under application ref: 24/00071/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: To ensure that the development is safe for the intended occupiers in accordance with Policy SI 12 of the London Plan 2021.

If, during the course of development, any contamination is found which has not been previously identified, work shall be suspended and additional measures for its remediation shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The remediation of the site shall incorporate the approved additional measures and a verification report for all the remediation works shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that risks from land contamination are minimised, in accordance with policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the final detailed drainage design approved under application ref: 23/02362/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site in accordance with relevant policy requirements including but not limited to Policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021, its associated Sustainable Design and Construction SPG, the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems and Policy DM4 of Kingston's Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the water efficiency measures approved under  application ref: 23/02486/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. To minimise the use of mains water, water supplies and ensure resources are protected and conserved in a sustainable manner in accordance with Policy SI 5 of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a car park management plan (detailing how the use of the parking will be managed, monitored and enforced and the signage necessary to direct pedestrians and vehicles) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved plan.Reason: To ensure the provision of adequate off-street parking in the interests of the safety and operation of the highway network, in accordance with policy T6 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS7 and DM9 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

No building hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.Reason: To comply with the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems, Policies SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan 2021, along with associated guidance to these policies and Policy DM4 of Kingston's Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the Landscape and Ecological Management Plan approved under application ref: 23/02382/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: To prevent harm to the biodiversity interests of the site.

Details, to include samples and manufacturer specifications, of the external facing materials, windows, doors, means of enclosure, external lighting and hard landscaping to be utilised in the development hereby permitted, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any above ground works on site are commenced (excluding demolition). The development shall then be built in accordance with these approved details.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the Hard and Soft landscaping Scheme approved under application ref: 24/00622/CLC and retained permanently thereafter, as far as they are not altered by the subject S73 application hereby approved. Reason: The ensure that a quality landscape is delivered.

The active nests of all wild birds are protected under the Wildlife & Countryside Act 1981 (As amended). An active nest is one being built, containing eggs or chicks, or on which fledged chicks are still dependent. All clearance, conversion and demolition work in association with the approved scheme shall be carried out outside of the bird nesting season which runs from March to August inclusive. If this is not possible clearance may only take place after a suitably qualified ecologist (SQE) has confirmed the absence of nesting birds or as agreed in writing with the Local Planning authority.Reason: To safeguard the biodiversity and nature conservation value of the site, in accordance with policy G6 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS3 and DM6 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or the use commenced until the deposited Fire Strategy Report (dated 02.05.2025) and Fire Statement (dated 30.04.2024) are implemented and the operation of the strategy maintained in perpetuity of the development unless otherwise agreed by the local planning authority. Reason: To ensure fire safety strategies are encouraged and implemented in accordance with Policy D12 of the London Plan 2021.

All lifts hereby approved shall be installed and operational prior to the first occupation of the floorspace hereby approved and retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure that inclusive and accessible routes are provided throughout the floorspace at all floors and also accessible routes through the site are provided to ensure no one is excluded from full use of the site in accordance with Policy D7 of the London Plan 2021.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the air source heat pump details approved under application ref: 25/01255/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the lighting details approved under application ref: 25/00576/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: To ensure that any resulting general or security lighting is appropriately located, designed to not adversely impact neighbouring residential amenity as well as protecting the biodiversity value of the site in accordance with Policy D3 and G6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy DM10 of the Council's Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the revised details of the west elevation approved under application ref: 23/02532/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: To ensure a good quality amenity space provision of the occupiers of the relevant flats as well as to ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The urban greening strategy shall be implemented strictly in accordance with the Urban Greening Factor Plan reference: 2114-CAM-03-ZZ-DR-L-0100 REV C09 prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted.Reason: To ensure compliance with Policy G5 of the London Plan

The development hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the Circular Economy Statement prepared by SoL Environment Ltd dated 12 October 2022.Reason: In the interests of sustainable waste management and in order to maximise the re-use of materials in accordance with Policy SI 7 of the London Plan 2021.

Should the community / commercial space, be used for a purposes falling within Use Class E(b) and E(g), then prior to first occupation, a scheme for the extraction and dispersal of all fumes and odours arising from the development (including details of its method of construction, odour control measures, noise levels, its appearance and its finish) shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and then implemented in full, prior to beneficial occupation. The measures which form the approved scheme shall be permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the details of secure cycle parking facilities approved under application ref: 23/02726/CLC and retained permanently thereafter, as far as they are not altered by the subject S73 application hereby approved. Reason: To ensure that appropriate opportunities to promote sustainable transport are taken up, in accordance with policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS6 and DM8 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to the commencement of any development above ground level, details of waste and recycling facilities to serve the development to which this permission relates shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The refuse and recycling facilities as shown in the approved details shall be provided prior to beneficial occupation of the development and shall be permanently retained thereafter. The developer and/or their successors in title shall take all reasonable steps to ensure that all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development are either stored within these facilities or internally within the building(s) on the application site, and that no refuse or recycling material is stored or placed for collection on the public highway except on the day of collection.Reason: To ensure proper waste management in the interests of the character and appearance of the area and the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

No plant, water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures, that are not shown on the approved plans, shall be erected upon the roofs of the buildings hereby permitted unless approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural quality buildings and to safeguard the character and appearance of the wider area.

Unless specified on the approved drawings, no lights (excluding aviation lights), meter boxes, flues, vents or pipes, and no telecommunications equipment masts or equipment or associated structures, alarm boxes, television aerials or satellite dishes shall be fixed or installed on the external face or roofs of the buildings, without the prior approval in writing of the local planning authorityReason: In order to safeguard the architectural quality buildings and to safeguard the character and appearance of the wider area.

2 car parking space(s) shall be provided with active provision for electric vehicle charging points and 2 further space(s) shall be provided with passive charging points.Reason: To ensure the provision of adequate off-street parking in the interests of the safety and operation of the highway network, in accordance with policy T6 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS7 and DM9 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The works shall be delivered in accordance with the Arboricultural Method Statement dated April2022 and the 1664-KC-XX-YTREE-TPP01 Rev A Tree Protection Plan. The approved Tree protection scheme shall be implemented prior to commencement of any work on site including demolition, and be maintained to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority until the completion of the development or until such stage as detailed within the approved AMS.Reason: To safeguard trees worthy of retention and in the interests of the character and appearance of the area, in accordance with policy G7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development shall be delivered in accordance with Hawks Road Clinic GLA Energy Strategy Rev P07 dated 22.11.2022.Reason: In the interests of sustainability and energy conservation in accordance with Policies SI 2 and SI 3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy DM1 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the wheelchair accessible and adaptable unit details approved under application ref: 23/02646/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: The details would affect subsequent design of other elements of the scheme and must be agreed at the outset and to ensure that an adequate level of accessible units are provided in accordance with Policies D5, D6 and D7 of the London Plan 2021, Policy DM13 of the RBK Core Strategy 2012 and the Mayor's Housing SPG 2016.

The development hereby permitted shall not incorporate the use of gas boilers.Reason: In the interests of sustainability and energy conservation in accordance with Policies SI 2 and SI 3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy DM1 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The works shall be delivered in accordance with the recommendations set out in Section 5 of the Bat Survey (April 2022).Reason: To safeguard the biodiversity and nature conservation value of the site, in accordance with policy G6 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS3 and DM6 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to occupation the applicant shall submit details to demonstrate that the PV installation has been delivered and maximised.Reason: In the interests of sustainability and energy conservation in accordance with Policies SI 2 and SI 3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy DM1 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to the occupation of each building the post-construction tab of the GLA's whole life carbon assessment template should be completed accurately and in its entirety in line with the GLA's Whole Life Carbon Assessment Guidance. The post-construction assessment should provide an update of the information submitted at the planning submission stage, including the whole life carbon emission figures for all life-cycle modules based on the actual materials, products and systems used. This should be submitted to the GLA at: ZeroCarbonPlanning@london.gov.uk, along with any supportingevidence as per the guidance. Confirmation of submission to the GLA shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority, prior to occupation of the relevant building.Reason: In the interests of sustainable development and to maximise on-site carbon dioxide savings.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the details confirming there is sufficient ducting space for full fibre connectivity infrastructure approved under application ref: 23/02504/CLC and retained permanently thereafter. Reason: To provide high quality digital connectivity infrastructure to contribute to London's global competitiveness.

Prior to the occupation the development hereby permitted, a Post Completion Report setting out the predicted and actual performance against all numerical targets in the relevant Circular Economy Statement shall be submitted to the GLA at: CircularEconomyLPG@london.gov.uk, along with any supporting evidence as per the GLA's Circular Economy Statement Guidance. The Post Completion Report shall provide updated versions of Tables 1 and 2 of the Circular Economy Statement, the Recycling and Waste Reporting form and Bill of Materials, Notification of the likely destination of all waste streams (beyond the Materials Recycling Facility) and Provide written confirmation that the destination landfill(s) has/have the capacity to receive waste. Confirmation of submission to the GLA shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority, prior to occupation. Reason: In the interests of sustainable waste management and in order to maximise the re-use of materials.

Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, a sample Welcome Pack containing guidance to future occupants on minimising future dwelling overheating risks shall have been submitted to and approved by the LPA. The welcome pack shall also include guidance to manage microclimate comfort in each of the units, management of the MVHR, acoustic management and the approved travel plan. The Welcome Pack shall be made available in each unit of accommodation.Reason: to ensure good quality accommodation in accordance with Policy D6 of the London Plan 2021.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the water capacity details approved under  application ref: 24/00083/CLC and retained permanently thereafter.Reason: The development may lead to no / low water pressure and network reinforcement works are anticipated to be necessary to ensure that sufficient capacity is made available to accommodate additional demand anticipated from the new development.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the Piling Method Statement approved under  application ref: 23/02365/CLC and retained permanently thereafter.Reason: The proposed works will be in close proximity to underground sewerage utility infrastructure. Piling has the potential to significantly impact / cause failure of local underground sewerage utility infrastructure.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the secure by design measures approved under  application ref: 23/02440/CLC and retained permanently thereafter.Reason: In order to achieve the principles and objectives of Secured by Design to improve community safety and crime prevention in accordance with policies CS 14 and DM 22 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012 and policy D11 of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to occupation a Secured by Design certificate or its equivalent awarded by a Designing Out Crime Officer from the Metropolitan Police Service on behalf of the National Police Chiefs Council shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In order to achieve the principles and objectives of Secured by Design to improve community safety and crime prevention in accordance with policies CS 14 and DM 22 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012 and policy D11 of the London Plan 2021.

Notwithstanding the submitted details, revised details of the rooftop plant and equipment shall have been submitted to and approved prior to the installation of any such equipment. The plant shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and retained as such.Reason: to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The non-residential floorspace hereby approved shall be used only for purposes within Class E and F2 (excluding in connection with the hiring, distribution of or trading in motor vehicles, or in connection with driving instruction), unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure the commercial space activates on this site are implemented as assessed in the application and to ensure a suitable mix of uses within the development and to safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity and/or parking pressures do not commence without prior approval.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the biodiversity method statement approved under  application ref: 24/00016/CLC and retained permanently thereafter, as far as they are not altered by the subject S73 application hereby approved. Reason: to ensure that the condition and status site can be retained (no net loss of biodiversity) and enhanced (biodiversity net gain)

Prior to the occupation of the non-residential units, details of the outside forecourt/outdoor space for those units associated with any of the non-residential uses hereby approved are to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing, including details of location, hours of use and any boundary treatment and furniture (temporary or permanent) prior to any use of such areas. The forecourt/outdoor spaces shall not be implemented other than in line with those details approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing, and in accordance with the approved Open SpaceManagement Plan, where appropriate.Reason: In the interests of the appearance of the development, the amenity of neighbouring residential properties and to ensure there is no street clutter.

A scheme detailing the provision and maintenance of green/biodiverse roofs for the development hereby permitted shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development. This shall include details of how these roofs will provide habitats and features for biodiversity (in accordance with definition of an extensive biodiverse roof and advice provided in The GRO Green Roof Code 2014). The agreed scheme shall be implemented as approved prior to first occupation of the development and thereafter maintained in accordance with the approved scheme.Reason: To enhance and protect the biodiversity value of the site and ensure adequate urban greening in accordance with policies G1 and G5 of the London Plan 2021.

The development hereby permitted shall be delivered in accordance with the deposited TM59 Overheating Analysis Rev 05 dated 20.10.2022 and all mitigation shall be provided prior to occupation and maintained thereafter.Reason: to ensure that any overheating risks are adequately managed.

All waste collection (domestic as well as commercial) shall only take place between 10am and 2.30pm Mondays - Fridays only.Reason: to ensure the free flow of traffic on Hawks Road as well as surrounding roads.

Prior to the commencement of any development above ground level, details of secure mobility scooter parking facilities to serve the development to which this permission relates shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The details shall demonstrate that level access as well as charging facilities. The scooter parking facilities as shown in the approved details shall be provided prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates and shall be permanently retained for that purpose and kept free from obstruction thereafter.Reason: To ensure the development is inclusive and adequately serves the needs of people who require the use of mobility scooters

description: Variation of Condition Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to carry out development without compliance with Condition 2 (Approved Plans), Condition 3 (Detail Drawing), Condition 23 (Hard and Soft Landscaping), Condition 25 (Fire Strategy Report), Condition30 (Urban Greening Strategy), Condition35 (Cycle Parking) and Condition 56 (Biodiversity Method Statement) of planning permission 22/01359/FUL (Demolition of existing Hawks Road Clinic to provide two buildings comprising flexible Use Class E and F2 floorspace and 125 Use Class C3 residential apartments, landscaping, parking facilities, cycle parking facilities, servicing, access and associated public realm improvements.) to vary the wording of Condition 2, Condition 25, Condition 30, to update landscaping plan and cycle parking, to vary the BNG calculation and method statement
